title.narrative: Strenghtened capacity of national tripartite constituents to promote Social and Solidarity Economy

description.narrative:
Barbados has a well-established sector grounded in social and solidarity principles, comprising a diverse range of actors commonly referred to as the Third Sector. These organizations play a vital role in both the productive and social spheres, contributing to employment generation while also supporting social protection and safety nets. However, they often face challenges related to performance, sustainability and operational resilience. In this context, constituents have requested, through the Decent Work Country Programme (DWCP), support to strengthen the enabling environment for these entities, with particular attention to organizations operating within the care economy.
The ILO has strong instruments to support the development of the Social and Solidarity sector, beginning with the promotion of evidence-based action planning and improved coordination. The initial area of support will focus on generating more robust data on the current state of the sector and its enabling environment through a participatory assessment.
